prompt: Avant-garde architectural exhibition poster in the style of Swiss International Typographic Style. Dominant clean negative white space. A monolithic curved brutalist concrete arch bathed in warm golden late-afternoon sunlight, casting a bold, razor-sharp diagonal shadow across a pristine smooth stone floor. A tiny solitary silhouette of a person standing at the edge of the shadow, providing scale and poetic tension. Typography is tastefully integrated into the empty space: the word 'ARCHITECTURA' set in elegant crisp black sans-serif font. Shot on medium format film, fine tactile grain, exquisite balance of light and shadow, museum-grade graphic design, minimalist masterpiece.

extra.name: 先锋极简视觉艺术海报 (Editorial Cover)
